name: Montonio Stargate Payments API
description: Montonio Stargate is an Estonian payment gateway API that enables merchants to create payment orders, manage payment intents, process refunds, and retrieve available payment methods. It supports bank payments, card payments, BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later) financing, and various local payment methods across the Baltics and Europe.
